title: Chapter 433 Zhao Bangde Enters The Secret Realm
content:
Chapter 433 Zhao Bangde Enters The Secret Realm

Wang Shuo stopped attacking and stood with his gun in hand.

The Demon King threw out a token, and Wang Shuo reached out to catch it. It was the token to enter the three-star secret realm.

"Wang Shuo, yes, given time, your future will be limitless."

"Thank you, His Majesty the Demon Emperor, for your approval." Wang Shuo looked at the token in his hand and breathed a sigh of relief.

It seems that this level has been passed for the time being.

After Wang Shuo left, Noen said to the Demon Emperor: "Your Majesty, why don't you keep this person? He is Shura."

The Demon King's eyes widened and he said in deep thought: "Are you teaching me how to do things?"

"I don't dare!" Noen immediately knelt down and said tremblingly.

"Hmph." The Demon King headed directly towards his retreat place.

Noen's head was dripping with cold sweat.

When Wang Shuo came out of the Demon Clan Royal Court, he broke into a cold sweat. After getting the token, Wang Shuo just wanted to rush back quickly and let Zhao Bondang enter the trial, hoping that he would break through as soon as possible.

Five days later, Wang Shuo returned to Shanhai City.

When you go, you need to keep exploring the way, and it will naturally be much faster to come back.

"Old Zhao, look, I brought the things back."

Zhao Bond was overjoyed when he saw the secret realm token.

He immediately summoned all the people who entered the secret realm this time.

After much thought, Wang Shuo also decided to leave only Ayub among his generals, and all the others followed Zhao Bond into the secret realm.

Before leaving, Wang Shuo handed over most of the accumulated water of life to Zhao Bond: "I am here waiting for your safe return."

Zhao Bondang immediately used the token, and then discovered that only humans could enter this secret realm.

No wonder the Demon King is so generous.

Entering the three-star secret realm this time, Dahuaiyu simply couldn't gather 50 generals.

Zhao Bangde took away all the generals except Wang Shuo and Ayub.

Wang Shuo looked at the empty square and sighed.

"This is really a gamble with all your strength!"

Wang Shuo then returned to Guancheng, while Ayub was stationed on the front line of the Great Wall, ready to respond to Wang Shuo at any time.

At the same time, Wang Shuo will hoard heavy troops on the front line of the Great Wall. If there is a war, he will directly abandon Guancheng.

In the next few days, Wang Shuo felt bored and had nothing to do. Wang Shuo decided to launch a selection event in the Dahuai Territory. He selected some talented practitioners and trained them personally to supplement the high-end combat power of the Dahuai Territory. missing situation.

The current military officer transfer certificate is no longer available.

Fortunately, they have already figured out how to make promotion pills, so as long as they practice hard, it is still easy to break through the bottleneck.

The previous use of military officer transfer certificates resulted in a large number of top military officers.

This group of people selected by Wang Shuo are all top military generals.

There are thousands of people in total, and the number of low-level generals is even greater.

The current reserves of low-level generals in Dahuai Region are sufficient.

The most difficult thing to break through is for intermediate warriors to break through to high-level warriors, because Dahuaiyu's current promotion pill no longer works.

Wang Shuo didn't know if there was a more advanced advancement pill.

During this period of time, it was a rare moment of peace. Wang Shuo was training top generals with peace of mind and teaching them how to break through bottlenecks, while Ayub was training ordinary soldiers and practicing more formation maneuvers.

Zhao Bondang, on the other hand, brought the top combat power of Da Huaiyu to conquer the three-star secret realm.

And other forces are also accumulating strength.

The years are quiet.

But in the center of the Shenwu Empire, a shocking war broke out.

All the major dependent countries were involved in the war.
